description: This file implements a runtime for managing multiple Language Server Protocol (LSP) sessions over stdio, including spawning server processes, handling JSON-RPC messaging, and creating tools for language features like hover, go-to-definition, and references within an agent framework.

classes.name: LspSession
classes.description: Represents an active LSP session with server name, process, request tracking, buffer, and capabilities.

classes.name: LspServerCapabilities
classes.description: Describes the capabilities of an LSP server, such as hover, definition, references providers.

classes.name: BundleLspToolRuntime
classes.description: Encapsulates the runtime environment managing multiple LSP sessions and tools, with a dispose method.

methods.name: encodeLspMessage
methods.description: Encodes a message body into an LSP JSON-RPC message with Content-Length header.

methods.name: parseLspMessages
methods.description: Parses a buffer string into individual LSP messages and remaining buffer.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a JSON-RPC request over an LSP session and returns a promise for the response.

methods.name: handleIncomingData
methods.description: Processes incoming data chunks, parses messages, and resolves or rejects pending requests.

methods.name: initializeSession
methods.description: Initializes an LSP session by sending initialize request and returning server capabilities.

methods.name: disposeSession
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down an LSP session, rejects pending requests, and kills the process.

methods.name: createLspPositionTool
methods.description: Creates a tool for position-based LSP requests like hover or go-to-definition.

methods.name: buildLspTools
methods.description: Builds a list of agent tools based on server capabilities (hover, definition, references).

methods.name: formatLspResult
methods.description: Formats the LSP response into an AgentToolResult with JSON string content.

methods.name: createBundleLspToolRuntime
methods.description: Creates the runtime environment, spawning servers, initializing sessions, and generating tools.
